name: Hazelnut Latte
source:
In this visual novel, you visit a café and find a young barista named Hazel. The two of you hit it off and the choice is up to you. What kind of coffee do you like? Do you want an espresso? Something sweet, like a frappe? Or do you want to try the special: A Hazelnut Latte? 

[From [url=https://radlord.itch.io/hazelnut-latte]Itch.io[/url]]
